answer: A hostile operator running 137 aliases therefore needs 120 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in nadir, expire in quill, and relic lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1449 identities would post 559 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
